description: The line plot illustrates the harmfulness ratio with refusals across different model configurations and datasets, with the x-axis representing the model size in terms of parameters (128, 256, 512, 1024) and the y-axis showing the harmfulness ratio with refusal, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5. Four distinct lines represent different combinations of models and datasets: LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue circles), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange squares), LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green triangles), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red diamonds). All lines show an increasing trend as model size increases. The Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red diamonds) starts at approximately 0.24 and rises to 0.52, showing the highest values across all sizes. The LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green triangles) begins at 0.06 and increases to 0.38. The Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange squares) starts at 0.15 and reaches 0.42. The LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue circles) starts at 0.20 and increases to 0.36. The plot demonstrates that the harmfulness ratio with refusal generally increases with model size, with the Qwen2-VL-7B model on MMSafetyBench exhibiting the highest performance across all sizes.
